themes.label: App praise: easy and quick
themes.definition: Positive app reviews: easy, fast, useful, smooth.

themes.label: App speed, loading and crashes
themes.definition: App is slow, will not open, freezes, crashes or shows 'something went wrong'.

themes.label: General dissatisfaction
themes.definition: Negative without a specific issue: 'worst bank', 'pathetic service'.

themes.label: App features and usability
themes.definition: Missing features, confusing design, keyboard, statement download in app, IPO ASBA, card-only login, dark mode, language.

themes.label: Card eligibility, upgrade and LTF requests
themes.definition: Eligibility criteria (Infinia, DCB), upgrade paths, lifetime-free requests, pre-approved offers.

themes.label: Card variant migration and forced upgrade
themes.definition: Card variants phased out or converted (Swiggy HDFC, Tata Neu, co-brand changes); forced upgrade or downgrade.

themes.label: Complaints closed without resolution
themes.definition: Complaints or tickets closed without a fix, generic replies, having to repeat the complaint, DMs with no outcome.

themes.label: Login, MPIN and registration
themes.definition: Cannot log in, register or verify; MPIN, password, OTP or SMS verification, device binding, forced re-registration.

themes.label: Rewards value, devaluation and caps
themes.definition: Reward-point value, devaluation, SmartBuy caps, milestone and accelerated-reward changes, spend criteria.

themes.label: Customer care unreachable or unhelpful
themes.definition: Cannot reach phone banking or chat, long waits, IVR loops, unhelpful bot (EVA) or agents.

themes.label: Card application, rejection and verification
themes.definition: Applications rejected, stuck in verification, video KYC, document checks.

themes.label: Product questions and advice-seeking
themes.definition: Neutral questions and comparisons: which card, is this worth it, how to apply.

themes.label: Device security blocks and false alerts
themes.definition: App refuses to run or disables itself because of device checks: developer options, USB debugging, root, 'security violation', 'device not compatible', risky-app warnings.

themes.label: New app and update experience
themes.definition: Reactions to the new HDFC Bank app or a recent update: migration, old app better, features lost after update.

themes.label: Account debit freezes and blocks
themes.definition: Accounts frozen or debit-blocked (KYC, undelivered letters, law-enforcement holds, suspicious activity), liens and holds.

themes.label: Card fees and charges
themes.definition: Annual and renewal fees, late fees, finance charges, no-cost EMI charges on cards.

themes.label: Reward redemption and vouchers
themes.definition: Redeeming points, vouchers not available or not received, milestone vouchers pending.

themes.label: Loan processing and disbursal
themes.definition: Loan applications, sanction, disbursal delays, valuation and verification, documentation.

themes.label: UPI payments failing or pending
themes.definition: UPI payments failing, pending, declined or blocked; UPI PIN; UPI limits.

themes.label: Credit limit
themes.definition: Credit limit too low, limit enhancement, limit cut.

themes.label: Account opening and product conversion
themes.definition: Opening savings or current accounts, pending opening, account variant conversion, minimum balance programmes.

themes.label: Account and card closure requests
themes.definition: Difficulty closing a card, account or loan; closure pending; charges after closure.

themes.label: Failed transaction reversal
themes.definition: Money debited but not received or not reversed; ATM cash not dispensed; failed transaction refund.

themes.label: Unsolicited sales calls and use of data
themes.definition: Repeated sales calls, spam, 'where did you get my number', marketing without consent.

themes.label: Card offers and deals
themes.definition: Merchant deals and discounts that mention HDFC cards (mostly promotional).

themes.label: KYC, re-KYC and profile updates
themes.definition: KYC and re-KYC, mobile number or address updates, nominee, PAN or Aadhaar linking.

themes.label: Branch service and staff behaviour
themes.definition: Branch visits, staff behaviour, rudeness, being sent to the home branch.

themes.label: Bank charges and hidden fees
themes.definition: Account charges, penalties, deductions without intimation, minimum balance penalties.

themes.label: EMI and loan account servicing
themes.definition: EMI schedule, EMI debit issues, loan details missing in app, interest-rate resets, part-payments.

themes.label: Fraud and scam calls
themes.definition: Scam calls and messages, impersonation, frauds reported by customers.

themes.label: Mis-selling and bundled products
themes.definition: Insurance or investments pushed with loans or accounts, misleading promises, ULIPs.

themes.label: Recovery and collection conduct
themes.definition: Recovery agents, collection calls, harassment, legal notices on dues.

themes.label: Relationship manager service
themes.definition: RM unreachable, RM changes, RM advice and conduct.

themes.label: Debit card and ATM
themes.definition: Debit card issues, ATM limits and failures, debit card variants.

themes.label: Praise for service
themes.definition: Customers praising staff, RMs, resolution or the bank overall.

themes.label: Phishing messages and fake links
themes.definition: Phishing SMS, fake links, fake apps, APK files.

themes.label: Card dispatch and delivery
themes.definition: Card or welcome kit not delivered, courier issues, activation after delivery.

themes.label: Disputes and chargebacks
themes.definition: Disputed transactions, chargebacks, dispute outcomes and delays.

themes.label: Refunds not credited
themes.definition: Merchant or excess-payment refunds not credited in time.

themes.label: Unauthorised transactions
themes.definition: Transactions the customer did not make, card misuse, money stolen from account.

themes.label: Investments, mutual funds and SmartWealth
themes.definition: Mutual funds, SIPs, portfolio tracking, SmartWealth.

themes.label: Loan closure, foreclosure and documents
themes.definition: Foreclosure, final settlement, NOC, release of original property documents.

themes.label: Other
themes.definition: Anything that fits no theme above.

themes.label: NetBanking
themes.definition: NetBanking access, errors and downtime.

themes.label: CIBIL and credit-report correction
themes.definition: Wrong entries on credit reports, CIBIL score impact, correction delays.

themes.label: Statements, certificates and documents
themes.definition: Statements, interest certificates, NOC or NDC, physical copies.

themes.label: NRI and forex services
themes.definition: NRI accounts, remittances, forex cards.

themes.label: Merchant QR, POS and sound box
themes.definition: Merchant apps and devices: QR, POS machine, sound box, settlements (SmartHub Vyapar).

themes.label: Deposits and interest rates
themes.definition: Fixed deposits, interest rates, sweep-in.

themes.label: Share price, results and corporate news
themes.definition: Stock-market, results and leadership news; not customer experience.

themes.label: Trading and IPO (HDFC Securities)
themes.definition: InvestRight trading app, orders, IPO, brokerage (group company).

themes.label: Insurance policies and claims (HDFC Life, ERGO)
themes.definition: Policy servicing, claims, premiums, surrender (group companies).

top_themes.label: Unsolicited sales calls and use of data
